_note: Solar sizing inputs. Yields are long-term averages for crystalline-silicon panels at optimum tilt (Global Solar Atlas PVOUT, data v1.7); flat, dusty or shaded rooftops produce a few percent less, and summer months produce more than winter. Costs are on-grid installed prices reported in the press; quotes vary with panel and inverter grade, so users enter their own. daytime_share is not measured data: it is the user's own answer to 'when do you use most power', shown to them as a percentage.
